name: drawer
title: Drawer
description: React Aria backed modal and non-modal push drawer/sheet primitive covering all four edge directions, with provider-aware portals, token-backed overlay/content styling, controlled open state, dismissal controls, spring-driven drag-to-dismiss, snap points, a draggable handle, an iOS-style backgroundScale page wrapper, opt-in edge-swipe-to-open, nested/stacked drawer auto-recede, a layoutId shared-element passthrough, none/subtle/standard/expressive motion presets, and reduced-motion fallbacks. Motion is a required runtime dependency; the core open/close/dismiss path stays fully functional when drag and spring polish are disabled by reduced motion or motionPreset="none".
